segment_summary.zh: 本段从客厅沙发与电视墙之间的区域向前移动，穿过客厅到达餐桌前的开口；随后左转，沿一条短走廊前行，经过墙面左侧的大幅装饰画，进入卧室并看到床。
segment_summary.en: In this segment the robot moved forward from the area between the living-room couch and the TV wall, crossed the living room to the opening in front of the dining table; it then turned left, went along a short hallway, passed a large decorative painting on the left wall, and entered the bedroom, where the bed was visible.

reason.zh: 任务要求沿走廊“经过右侧的画”再进入卧室，但 F79 显示大幅画位于行进方向的左侧墙面，卧室入口和床位于右侧，画与卧室入口的左右关系与任务描述明确相反，因此本段发生偏航。
reason.en: The task requires passing the painting on the right while following the hallway and then entering the bedroom, but F79 shows the large painting on the left wall in the direction of travel, with the bedroom opening and bed on the right; this left-right relationship between the painting and the bedroom entrance is clearly opposite to the task description, so this segment deviated.

instruction_evidence.quote_en: past the painting on your right, and enter the bedroom
instruction_evidence.quote_zh: 经过你右侧的画，然后进入卧室。

description.en: F24 shows the TV wall on the left and the couch on the right; F42 moves forward along one side of the TV wall; F61 reaches the opening toward the dining table, indicating that this segment moved forward from the living room to that opening.
